chapter.v:
When Israel
went out of Egypt,the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

Judah became
his sanctuary,Israel his dominion.

The sea
saw it, and fled.The Jordan was driven back.

The mountains
skipped like rams,the little hills like lambs.

What was
it, you sea, that you fled?You Jordan, that you turned back?

You mountains,
that you skipped like rams?You little hills, like lambs?

Tremble, you
earth, at the presence of the Lord,at the presence of the God of Jacob,

who turned
the rock into a pool of water,the flint into a spring of waters.
